primary_source.title: Identification of Novel Drug Candidate for Epithelial Ovarian Cancer via In Silico Investigation and In Vitro Validation

prior_context.context_boundary: Different-source prior abstract annotations are not full-primary qualifications and their normal-cell/BUB1B/genetic/animal claims are not assigned to this study. No existing object changed.

identity.preparation_equivalence: No transfer to piperine,plants,extracts,food,oral products or human exposure.

ho8910_registry.finding: Contaminated HeLa derivative; ICLAC-00606. Preserve cell response but not authenticated independent ovarian identity.

positive_evidence.scope: Lower cancer-cell MTT signal with dose and time; author IC50 values not refitted. Figure axes: SK-OV-3/HO-8910 0–100 µM; CA-OV-3 0–20 µM.

Significant reductions in colony numbers at 10/20 µM in all three named lines; orthogonal to MTT and after withdrawal according to Methods. Schedule and denominator conflicts limit exact protocol and absolute-count interpretation.
Higher apoptotic fraction with significance marks at both active doses; distinct assay from MTT. No individual cytometry plots or event counts. Time-point mapping unresolved.
Representative bands decrease; not biochemical inhibition or engagement, and no BUBR1 assay. No displayed densitometry or exact protein P-value.

replication_and_statistics.methods: At least three independent experiments; explicitly three for colonies/apoptosis; mean±SD; Student t-test or one-way ANOVA. Figure6 names an unspecified multiple-comparison test.
limits: Technical wells and culture passages not mapped
No independent biological replication by reviewer

docking.comparator_role: Computational reference only; no administered AZD5438 arm

mechanism.judgment: Docking plus lower protein abundance cannot establish direct, selective CDK1-mediated death.

bub1b.role: Tumor-versus-normal expression list and computational hub
bub1b.supplement_direction: Upregulated in the tumor-dataset intersection; not a PL-treated comparison

source_issues.source: Methods Colony Formation versus Figure6 caption
source_issues.detail: Methods: 200 cells/well, then 24 h exposure, withdrawal and 14 days growth. Caption: treatment then plating and 7 days growth. Exact sequence and duration unresolved.
Native SK-OV-3 control mean exceeds 400 colonies and CA-OV-3 exceeds 200, versus 200 plated cells. No stated aggregation explains the count; no repaired values supplied.

Conditional direct dilution of 10 mM DMSO stock to 100 µM gives 1% DMSO, exceeding the stated maximum 0.5%; no alternate stock or solvent exchange described. This is not proof of vehicle artifact at 10–20 µM.
Dose-only bars do not separately map 24/48 h. Prose gives SKOV3 at 20 µM: 37.6%/53.4%; retained as author-reported, not independently verified at both times from the graph.
Control lanes labeled Vector without described transfection; not evidence of genetic manipulation or rescue.
296 = 115 up + 181 down is supported by the supplement; Discussion gives 247 = 103 + 144.
Final limitation says one cell line; three named lines are displayed. HO-8910 is separately flagged as a HeLa derivative by the official registry.

absence_scope: Only the reviewed paper and package; no broad absence claim across PL literature. Missing controls do not establish harm or artifact.
competitive_assessment: Real anticancer cellular outcomes retained; no useful-normal-function or BUB1B/MVA defect rescue. Niacin and apitegromab remain provisional and unproven in MVA; this paper does not establish a basis for promoting PL above them.
recommended_disposition: Experimental anticancer comparator, not an MVA lead; primary mechanism and normal-cell selectivity gaps remain unresolved
followup_questions: Can direct CDK1 engagement and causality be demonstrated apart from cytotoxicity or cell-composition changes?
What are matched normal/BUB1B-deficient functional outcomes at verified exposure?
Resolve colony denominator/schedule, vehicle, cytometry timing and cell authentication before quantitative follow-up.
